```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(jsonlite)

sub_name_translation <- c(

# Custom renaming function: ONLY feature name
rename_features_only <- function(var_names) {
  sapply(var_names, function(var) {
    parts <- str_split(var, "_", n = 3)[[1]]
    
    if (length(parts) < 3) return(var)  # Leave ID variable alone

    feature_raw <- parts[3]

    feature <- case_when(
      feature_raw == "Count" ~ "Count",
      feature_raw == "Epithelium-Lamina propria ratio" ~ "Epi-LP",
      feature_raw == "% in clusters" ~ "Clusters",
      feature_raw == "Size (mean)" ~ "Mean\nsize",
      feature_raw == "Size (sd)" ~ "SD\nsize",
      str_detect(feature_raw, "distance \\(mean\\)") ~ "Mean\ndistance",
      str_detect(feature_raw, "distance \\(sd\\)") ~ "SD\ndistance",
      TRUE ~ feature_raw
    )
    feature
  }, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}
 
rename_custom_vars <- function(var_names) {
  sapply(var_names, function(var) {
    parts <- str_split(var, "_", n = 3)[[1]]
    
    # If not a 3-part name, return original
    if (length(parts) < 3) return(var)

    # Original components
    layer <- parts[1]
    compartment <- parts[2]
    feature_raw <- parts[3]

    # Abbreviate compartment
    compartment_abbr <- case_when(
      compartment == "Epithelium" ~ "Epi",
      compartment == "Lamina propria" ~ "LP",
      TRUE ~ compartment
    )

    # Custom feature name abbreviation
    feature <- case_when(
      feature_raw == "Count" ~ "Count",
      feature_raw == "Epithelium-Lamina propria ratio" ~ "Epi-LP",
      feature_raw == "% in clusters" ~ "Clust",
      feature_raw == "Size (mean)" ~ "Mean size",
      feature_raw == "Size (sd)" ~ "SD size",
      str_detect(feature_raw, "distance \\(mean\\)") ~ "Mean dist",
      str_detect(feature_raw, "distance \\(sd\\)") ~ "SD dist",
      TRUE ~ feature_raw
    )

    paste0(feature, "\n", layer, " ", compartment_abbr)
  }, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}



prepare_pca_full_analysis <- function(df,
                                      id_col = "image_fragment_mucosa_name",
                                      exclude_cols = c("image_fragment_mucosa_name"),
                                      scale_data = FALSE,
                                      explore_dir = cluster_prep_dir,
                                      prefix = subset_name) {
  
  if(!dir.exists(explore_dir)) dir.create(explore_dir, recursive = TRUE)

  # Prepare data
  df_for_pca <- df %>%
    select(-all_of(exclude_cols)) %>%
    drop_na()
  
  # Shorten variable names using provided rename function
  short_var_names <- rename_custom_vars(names(df_for_pca))
  colnames(df_for_pca) <- short_var_names
  
  # PCA
  pca <- prcomp(df_for_pca, center = scale_data, scale. = scale_data)
  
  # Scree plot
  scree_plot <- fviz_eig(pca, addlabels = TRUE, ylim = c(0, 100)) +
    ggtitle(NULL) +
    ylab("Percentage of variance") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 9)
  ggsave(file.path(explore_dir, paste0("scree_plot_", prefix, ".png")),
         scree_plot, width = 7, height = 3.3, dpi = 300)
  
  print(scree_plot)
  

  
  # Variable contributions
  var_contrib <- get_pca_var(pca)$contrib %>% as.data.frame()
  var_contrib <- var_contrib %>% 
    rownames_to_column("Variable") %>%
    arrange(desc(Dim.1))
  
  # Save contributions table
  write_json(var_contrib, file.path(explore_dir, paste0("variable_contributions_", prefix, ".json")))
  
  loadings <- as.data.frame(pca$rotation) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "Variable") %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = starts_with("PC"),
      names_to = "PrincipalComponent",
      values_to = "Loading"
    ) %>%
    filter(PrincipalComponent %in% paste0("PC", 1:6))  # first 9 PCs
  
  loadings$Variable <- str_replace_all(loadings$Variable, "\n", " - ")
  
  custom_order <- c(
  "Count - Villi LP", "Mean dist - Villi LP", "SD dist - Villi LP",
  "Count - Crypts LP", "Mean dist - Crypts LP", "SD dist - Crypts LP",
  "Count - Villi Epi", "Mean dist - Villi Epi", "SD dist - Villi Epi",
  "Count - Crypts Epi", "Mean dist - Crypts Epi", "SD dist - Crypts Epi",
  "Epi-LP - Villi LP", "Epi-LP - Crypts LP",
  "Mean size - Villi LP", "Mean size - Crypts LP",
  "Mean size - Villi Epi", "Mean size - Crypts Epi",
  "SD size - Villi LP", "SD size - Crypts LP",
  "SD size - Villi Epi", "SD size - Crypts Epi"
  )
  
  # Reorder Variable as factor
  loadings$Variable <- factor(loadings$Variable, levels = custom_order)

  
  var_plot <- ggplot(loadings, aes(x = Variable, y = Loading)) +
    geom_col(aes(fill = Variable)) +
    facet_wrap(~ PrincipalComponent, scales = "free_y") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.box = "vertical"
    ) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 1)) +
    labs(
      title = "Variable loadings by principal component",
      y = "Loading", x = "", fill = "Variable"
    )
  
  ggsave(file.path(explore_dir, paste0("var_load_by_PC_", prefix, ".png")),
         var_plot, width = 7, height = 7, dpi = 300)
  print(var_plot)
  
  # Generate and save biplots 
  pc_count <- min(4, ncol(pca$x))  
  
  biplots <- list()
  for(i in 1:(pc_count-1)) {
    for(j in (i+1):pc_count) {
      pcs <- c(i, j)
      contrib_i <- sort(get_pca_var(pca)$contrib[, i], decreasing = TRUE)
      contrib_j <- sort(get_pca_var(pca)$contrib[, j], decreasing = TRUE)
      
      
      # Create biplot
      biplot <- fviz_pca_biplot(pca, axes = pcs,
                                geom.ind = "point",
                               # select.var = list(name = top_vars),
                                col.ind = "lightblue",
                               pointsize = 1.2,
                               labelsize = 3,
                                col.var = "contrib",
                                gradient.cols = c("#fd8d3c", "#f03b20", "#bd0026"),
                                repel = TRUE) +
        ggtitle(paste("Biplot PC", i, "vs PC", j)) +
        theme_bw(base_size = 9)
      
      # Save plot
      plot_name <- paste0("biplot_PC", i, "_PC", j, "_", prefix, ".png")
      ggsave(file.path(explore_dir, plot_name),
             biplot, width = 7, height = 3.5, dpi = 300)
      
      biplots[[paste0("PC", i, "_PC", j)]] <- biplot
      
      print(biplot)
    }
  }
  
  # Return results invisibly
  invisible(list(
    pca = pca,
    df_for_pca = df_for_pca,
    scree_plot = scree_plot,
    var_contrib = var_contrib,
    biplots = biplots
  ))
}


plot_kmeans_elbow_silhouette <- function(pca, 
                                         pcs = 1:6, 
                                         kmax = 15, 
                                         explore_dir = cluster_prep_dir,
                                         prefix = subset_name) {
  
  df_for_clust <- as.data.frame(pca$x[, pcs])
  
  # Elbow plot (WSS)
  elbow_plot <- fviz_nbclust(df_for_clust, kmeans, method = "wss", k.max = kmax) +
    labs(
      x = "Number of clusters (k)",
      y = "Total within-cluster\nsum of squares"
    ) +
    ggtitle(NULL) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 9, base_family = "Arial") +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 9),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 9)
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(breaks = as.character(seq(1, kmax, by = 1)))

  # Save elbow plot
  elbow_path <- file.path(explore_dir, paste0("elbow_plot_", prefix, ".png"))
  ggsave(filename = elbow_path,
         plot = elbow_plot, width = 7, height = 7, dpi = 300)
  
  print(elbow_plot)
  
  # Silhouette plot
  silhouette_plot <- fviz_nbclust(df_for_clust, kmeans, method = "silhouette", k.max = kmax) +
    labs(
      x = "Number of clusters (k)",
      y = "Average silhouette width"
    ) +
    ggtitle(NULL) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 9, base_family = "Arial") +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 9),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 9)
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(breaks = as.character(seq(1, kmax, by = 1)))
  
  # Save silhouette plot
  silhouette_path <- file.path(explore_dir, paste0("silhouette_plot_", prefix, ".png"))
  ggsave(filename = silhouette_path,
         plot = silhouette_plot, width = 7, height = 7, dpi = 300)
  
  print(silhouette_plot)
  
  invisible(list(
    df_for_clust = df_for_clust,
    plots = list(elbow = elbow_plot, silhouette = silhouette_plot),
    paths = list(elbow_plot = elbow_path, silhouette_plot = silhouette_path)
  ))
}

cluster_k <- function(pca,
                      best_k,
                      original_df,
                      pcs_used = NULL,
                      dir = cluster_prep_dir,
                      prefix = subset_name) {
  set.seed(123)
  
  df_for_clust <- as.data.frame(pca$x[, pcs_used])

  km <- kmeans(df_for_clust, centers = best_k, nstart = 25)

  # Define color palette with sufficient colors
  if(best_k <= 8){
    palette <- brewer.pal(8, "Dark2")[1:best_k]
  } else if(best_k <= 12){
    palette <- brewer.pal(best_k, "Set3")
  } else {
    # For more than 12 clusters, use a larger palette
    palette <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(12, "Set3"))(best_k)
  }

  # Helper function to make PCA plots
  make_pca_cluster_plot <- function(pc_x, pc_y){
    plot <- fviz_pca_ind(
      pca,
      axes = c(pc_x, pc_y),
      geom.ind = "point",
      pointshape = 21,
      fill.ind = factor(km$cluster),
      col.ind = "black",
      palette = palette,
      addEllipses = TRUE,
      ellipse.level = 0.90,
      repel = TRUE,
      legend.title = "Cluster"
    ) +
    ggtitle(paste("Clusters on PC", pc_x, "vs PC", pc_y)) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
    theme(
      text = element_text(family = "Arial"),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 9),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 9),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 9),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 9)
    )
    return(plot)
  }

  # Define which PC combinations to plot
  pc_combinations <- list(c(1,2), c(1,3), c(1,4), c(2,3), c(2,4))
  plots <- list()

  # Generate and save each PCA cluster plot
  for(pcs in pc_combinations){
    p <- make_pca_cluster_plot(pcs[1], pcs[2])
    plot_name <- paste0("pca_clusters_PC", pcs[1], "_PC", pcs[2], "_", prefix, ".png")
    ggsave(
      filename = file.path(dir, plot_name),
      plot = p,
      width = 7, height = 3.5, units = "in", dpi = 300
    )
    plots[[paste0("PC", pcs[1], "_PC", pcs[2])]] <- p
    print(p)
  }

  # Assign clusters back to original data
  cluster_assignments <- original_df %>%
    mutate(cluster = km$cluster[match(rownames(original_df), rownames(df_for_clust))])

  # Calculate distances to cluster centers (PCA space)
  distances <- sqrt(rowSums((df_for_clust - km$centers[km$cluster, ])^2))
  cluster_assignments$distance_to_center <- distances[match(rownames(original_df), rownames(df_for_clust))]

  # Return cluster data, PCA plots, and assignments
  invisible(list(
    clustered_data = cluster_assignments,
    cluster_object = km,
    pca_plots = plots
  ))
}


prepare_for_clustering <- function(df, 
                                   id_col = "image_fragment_mucosa_name", 
                                   exclude_cols = c("image_fragment_mucosa_name"),
                                   scale_data = FALSE,
                                   dir = "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_papers/lymphocyte_distribution_patterns_in_feline_small_intestinal_biopsies/output/cluster_prep//", 
                                   prefix = "",
                                   kmax = 30) {
  # Clean and subset data for clustering
  df_for_clust <- df %>%
    select(-all_of(exclude_cols)) %>%
    drop_na()
  
  # Keep IDs aligned with filtered data (optional return)
  id_df <- df %>%
    drop_na() %>%
    select(all_of(id_col)) %>%
    slice(match(rownames(df_for_clust), rownames(df_for_clust)))
  
  # Scale if requested
  if(scale_data) {
    df_for_clust <- scale(df_for_clust)
  }
  
  # PCA (no centering/scaling if scale_data=FALSE, otherwise prcomp defaults)
  pca <- prcomp(df_for_clust, center = scale_data, scale. = scale_data)
  
  # Scree plot
  scree_plot <- fviz_eig(pca, addlabels = TRUE, ylim = c(0, 100)) +
    ggtitle(NULL) +
    ylab("Percentage\nof variance") +  # <- this is the split label
    theme_bw(base_size = 9, base_family = "Arial") +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 9),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 9)
    )
  print(scree_plot)
  ggsave(filename = file.path(explore_dir, paste0("scree_plot_", prefix, ".png")),
         plot = scree_plot, width = 7, height = 2.25, dpi = 300)
  
  # PCA biplot
  biplot <- fviz_pca_biplot(pca,
                            geom.ind = "point",
                            col.ind = "lightblue",
                            col.var = "contrib",
                            gradient.cols = c("#fd8d3c", "#f03b20", "#bd0026"),
                            repel = TRUE) +
    ggtitle(NULL) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
    theme(
      text = element_text(family = "Arial"),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      panel.grid = element_blank()
    )
  print(biplot)
  ggsave(filename = file.path(explore_dir, paste0("pca_biplot_", prefix, ".png")),
         plot = biplot, width = 7, height = 7, dpi = 300)
  
  # Elbow plot for kmeans
  elbow <- fviz_nbclust(df_for_clust, kmeans, method = "wss", k.max = kmax) +
    labs(
      x = "Number of clusters (k)",
      y = "Total within-cluster\nsum of squares"
    ) +
    ggtitle(NULL) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 9, base_family = "Arial") +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 9),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 9)) +
    scale_x_discrete(breaks = as.character(seq(1, kmax, by = 5)))
  
  print(elbow)
  ggsave(filename = file.path(explore_dir, paste0("elbow_plot_", prefix, ".png")),
         plot = elbow, width = 7, height = 7, dpi = 300)
  
  # Silhouette plot for kmeans
  silhouette <- fviz_nbclust(df_for_clust, kmeans, method = "silhouette", k.max = kmax) +
    labs(
      x = "Number of clusters (k)",
      y = "Average silhouette width"
    ) +
    ggtitle(NULL) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 9, base_family = "Arial") +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 9),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 9)) +
    scale_x_discrete(breaks = as.character(seq(1, kmax, by = 5)))
  
  print(silhouette)
  ggsave(filename = file.path(explore_dir, paste0("silhouette_plot_", prefix, ".png")),
         plot = silhouette, width = 7, height = 7, dpi = 300)
  
  # Return cleaned data, IDs, PCA, and plots invisibly for further use
  list(
    df_for_clust = df_for_clust,
    id_df = id_df,
    pca = pca,
    plots = list(scree_plot = scree_plot, biplot = biplot, elbow = elbow, silhouette = silhouette)
  )
}





prepare_cluster_summary <- function(
  clust_obj,         # list from prepare_for_clustering
  best_k,            # chosen number of clusters
  original_df,       # full, untransformed data with all rows
  explore_features_dir = "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_papers/lymphocyte_distribution_patterns_in_feline_small_intestinal_biopsies/output/explore_lymphocyte_distribution/",
  prefix = "Crypts - lamina propria"
) {
  
  set.seed(123)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(factoextra)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(stringr)

  # Extract necessary components
  df_for_clust <- clust_obj$df_for_clust
  pca <- clust_obj$pca
  id_df <- clust_obj$id_df

  # K-means clustering
  km <- kmeans(df_for_clust, centers = best_k, nstart = 25)

  # Create PCA biplot with clusters
  cluster_plot <- fviz_pca_ind(
    pca,
    geom.ind = "point",
    pointshape = 21,
    fill.ind = factor(km$cluster),
    col.ind = "black",
    palette = "Dark2",
    addEllipses = TRUE,
    ellipse.level = 0.90,
    repel = TRUE,
    legend.title = "") +
    ggtitle(NULL) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
    theme(
      text = element_text(family = "Arial"),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 9),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 9),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 9)
    )

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(explore_features_dir, paste0("pca_of_kmeans_", prefix, ".png")),
    plot = cluster_plot,
    width = 7, height = 2.25, units = "in", dpi = 300
  )
  
  print(cluster_plot)

  # Assign clusters to IDs
  cluster_df <- id_df %>%
    mutate(cluster = km$cluster)

  # Compute distances to cluster centers (to assess central vs peripheral)
  centers_pca_space <- predict(pca, newdata = km$centers)
  obs_pca_space <- as.data.frame(pca$x[, 1:ncol(centers_pca_space)])
  distances <- purrr::map_dbl(1:nrow(obs_pca_space), function(i) {
    cl <- km$cluster[i]
    sqrt(sum((obs_pca_space[i, ] - centers_pca_space[cl, ])^2))
  })
  cluster_df$distance_to_center <- distances

  # Summary of original (raw) variables by cluster
  original_summary <- original_df %>%
    mutate(cluster = km$cluster[match(rownames(original_df), rownames(df_for_clust))]) %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
    summarise(across(where(is.numeric), list(mean = mean, sd = sd), .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"))

  # Return both the assignment and summary
  list(
    cluster_assignments = cluster_df,
    cluster_summary = original_summary
  )
}

db_cluster_summary <- function(
  clust_obj,# list from prepare_for_clustering
  pc_n, #number of principal components
  eps,         #epsilon for dbscan
  minPts,  #minPts for dbscan
  explore_features_dir = "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_papers/lymphocyte_distribution_patterns_in_feline_small_intestinal_biopsies/output/explore_lymphocyte_distribution/",
  prefix = ""
) {
  
  set.seed(123)
  library(factoextra)
  library(tidyverse)
  library(dbscan)
  library(RANN)

  # Extract necessary components
  df_for_clust <- clust_obj$df_for_clust
  pca <- clust_obj$pca
  id_df <- clust_obj$id_df
  
  pca_data <- as.data.frame(pca$x[,1:pc_n])

  # K-means clustering
  db <- dbscan(pca_data, eps = eps, minPts = minPts)


  # Create PCA biplot with clusters
  cluster_plot <- fviz_pca_ind(
    pca,
    geom.ind = "point",
    pointshape = 21,
    fill.ind = factor(db$cluster),
    col.ind = "black",
    palette = "Dark2",
    addEllipses = TRUE,
    ellipse.level = 0.90,
    repel = TRUE,
    legend.title = "") +
    ggtitle(paste0("DBSCAN of PC1 to PC", pc_n, "; epsilon = ", eps, "MinPts = ", minPts )) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
    theme(
      text = element_text(family = "Arial"),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 9),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 9),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 9)
    )

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(explore_features_dir, paste0("pca_of_dbscan_pcn_", pc_n, "_eps_", eps, "_MinPts_", minPts, ".png")),
    plot = cluster_plot,
    width = 7, height = 6.8, units = "in", dpi = 300
  )
  
  print(cluster_plot)
  
  nn_result <- RANN::nn2(data = pca_data, k = 2)
  nearest_distances <- nn_result$nn.dists[, 2]
  df_nn <- pca_data %>%
    mutate(nearest_neighbor_dist = nearest_distances)
  
  nn_plot <- ggplot(df_nn, aes(nearest_neighbor_dist)) +
    geom_histogram(bin_width = 0.1) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 10)) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 9) + 
    labs(title = paste0("Nearest neigbhbor distance in PCA space (PC 1-)", pc_n),
         x = "Nearest neighbor distance",
         y = "Count")
  
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(explore_features_dir, paste0("nn_for_pca_pcn_1_", pc_n, ".png")),
    plot = nn_plot,
    width = 3.5, height = 2.25, units = "in", dpi = 300
  )

  # Assign clusters to IDs
  cluster_df <- id_df %>%
    mutate(cluster = db$cluster, 
           nn_dist = df_nn$nearest_neighbor_dist)
  

  cluster_df
}

```




### PCA 
```{r}
subset_name <- "batch_1"
filtered_scaled <- fromJSON(paste0(explore_unscaled_dir, "filtered_scaled_",subset_name ,".json")) %>%
   select(- ends_with("_% in clusters")) %>%
     select(- ends_with("_Junctional distance (median)")) 
     
  
pca_prep <- prepare_pca_full_analysis(filtered_scaled)
var_cont <- pca_prep$var_contrib
```

### K-means

```{r}

nn_pca <- function(all_cluster_prep, PC_n = 3 ){ #number of pc for clustering
                         
  pca <- all_cluster_prep$pca
  pca_scores <- as.data.frame(pca$x[, 1:PC_n])
  
  #check distribution of nn points to decide dbscan
  nn_result <- RANN::nn2(data = pc_scores, k = 2)
  nearest_distances <- nn_result$nn.dists[, 2]
  df_nn <- pc_scores %>%
    mutate(nearest_neighbor_dist = nearest_distances)
  
  nn_pca_plot <- ggplot(df_nn, aes(x = nearest_neighbor_dist)) +
    geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.1) +  
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 10)) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
  labs(
    title = "Distance to Nearest Neighbor in PCA Space",
    x = "Nearest Neighbor Distance",
    y = "Count"
  )
  return(nn_pca_plot)
}

#Plot distance to nearest neigbor in pca space
nn_pca_plot <- nn_pca(all_cluster_prep)
nn_pca_plot

dbscan_plots <- function(all_cluster_prep,
                         eps_vals,
                         minPts = 2,
                         PC_n = 3) {
  results <- list()
  id_df <- all_cluster_prep$id_df
  pca <- all_cluster_prep$pca
  pca_scores <- as.data.frame(pca$x[,1:PC_n])
  
  for(eps in eps_vals){
    db <- dbscan(pca_scores, eps = eps, minPts = minPts)
    df_plot <- pca_scores %>%
      mutate(cluster = as.factor(db$cluster),
             image_fragment_mucosa_name = id_df$image_fragment_mucosa_name,
             eps = eps,
             minPts = minPts)
  }
}
  
  
#Try dbscan for different thresholds
eps_vals = c(0.5, 0.75, 1, 1.25, 1.5)

```
